text: Men lonngini neene Muusaa on (yo o his) Men wi'i: muynin mo si a hulii Fir'awna e yimɓe makko ɓen wata ɓe waru mo, haray waɗu mo e hontoore, werloɗaa nde ka caangol Nila, wata a hulu himo yooli wata a hulu Fir'awna no waɗi mo goɗɗum, wata a suno sabu seedugol e makko, Menen Men artiray mo ka maaɗa hara himo wuuri, Men waɗay mo kadi jeyaaɗo e Nulaaɓe Alla ɓen, ɓen ɓe O Nulata faade e tagu Makko ngun.
